mapper.insert: /* ServiceRequestMapper.saveServiceRequest */ INSERT INTO SERVICE_REQUEST (USR_SN, CAT_SN, SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_TTL, SVC_REQ_CN, SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, SVC_REQ_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{usrSn}, #{catSn}, #{formTemplateSn}, #{svcReqTtl}, #{svcReqCn}, #{svcReqBdgtAmt}, #{svcReqStatusCd}, #{svcReqRegId}, #{svcReqUpdtId})
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestMapper.findServiceRequestById */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestMapper.findPublicServiceRequestById */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestMapper.findMyServiceRequests */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0001'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0003'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0004'
ORDER BY s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT DESC
